scope: Read-only actual prepared ObjectPropertiesView mount/render/callback closure; no Native or compiler execution

findings.behavior: Original View constructs Torah model before guarded VM. Model update invokes internalIdentityStatus, which can start original bootstrapSpace Task when canonical metadata is not ready. Suppressing observeDocument does not suppress construction.

Visible section filtering may call the same policy resolver from the rendered View. isResolvingManifest itself is pure, but is based on stored initializer state; with its observer suppressed a prepared route can retain loading state without refresh.

Loading retry invokes identity retry and independent session refresh. Missing-output native property fallback invokes model.edit/update and can present an independently owned Torah editor. Disabling only the Torah section does not contain these routes.
All session host machinery is under if let session. The nil branch returns only content; it creates no default session or observer. This is the prepared route containment seam.

The preimage calls side-effecting internal-property policy before scheduling the same Owner. Root is replacing this only for prepared routes with pre-Task same-Owner reservation and current canonical identity read.
Original initializer and subscription callback filter through policy. Root owns fresh identity read, live document/property comparison, cancellation and original builder publication.
Prepared routes invoke requireQualifiedSchemaRoute before policy, catalog or Tasks. These feature routes remain explicitly unqualified; this audit does not claim them implemented.

The original section builder is pure array grouping. Original row delegates do not themselves start native work; parent editing callbacks determine authority. Section expansion/conflict info are source-checked UI publication.

minimal_implementation.behavior: Optional original Torah model constructed only on nil prepared route. Prepared uses original model.sections and no Torah loading/filter/section/session. Same original renderer and legacy nil route retained.

pending_peer_issue.description: Prepared VM task reattachment must not lose subscriptions if a new retained-State task starts before cancelled predecessor cleanup. This View patch leaves original model.setupSubscriptions task unchanged.
